--!strict

if globalEnv.DevAssetProfilerCleanup then
	pcall(globalEnv.DevAssetProfilerCleanup)
end

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
if not LocalPlayer then
	Players:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Wait()
	LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
end

-- Weak table to track instances without memory leaks or GetFullName() collisions
if not globalEnv.TrackerLoadedInstances then
	globalEnv.TrackerLoadedInstances = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
end
local seenInstances: {[Instance]: boolean} = globalEnv.TrackerLoadedInstances

local connections: {RBXScriptConnection} = {}
local function bind(signal: RBXScriptSignal, fn: (...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
	local conn = signal:Connect(fn)
	table.insert(connections, conn)
	return conn
end

local CONFIG = {
	BatchSize = 25,
	MaxWorkers = 4,
	ErrorPageSize = 50,
	SearchDebounce = 0.15,
	AnimSpeed = 0.18,
	MinWidth = 380,

local function create(className: string, props: {[string]: any}?): any
	local inst = Instance.new(className)
	if props then
		local parent = props.Parent
		for k, v in pairs(props) do
			if k ~= "Parent" then
				(inst :: any)[k] = v
			end
		end
		if parent then
			inst.Parent = parent
		end
	end
	return inst
end

local function corner(parent: Instance, radius: number): UICorner
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
	c.Parent = parent
	return c
end

local function stroke(parent: Instance, color: Color3, thickness: number?): UIStroke
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Color = color
	s.Thickness = thickness or 1
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
	s.Parent = parent
	return s
end

local function getGuiRoot(): Instance
	local ok, target = pcall(function()
		return (typeof(gethui) == "function" and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
	end)
	if ok and target then
		local canParent = pcall(function()
			local t = Instance.new("Folder")
			t.Parent = target
			t:Destroy()
		end)
		if canParent then return target end
	end
	return LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

type FailedRecord = {
	id: string,
	name: string,
	fullName: string,
	assetType: string,
	contentId: string,
	targetInstance: Instance?,

	retries: number,
}

	MeshPart = "Mesh", SpecialMesh = "Mesh", Decal = "Decal", Texture = "Texture",
	SurfaceAppearance = "PBR Material", Sound = "Audio", Animation = "Animation",
	ImageLabel = "UI Image", ImageButton = "UI Image", ParticleEmitter = "VFX Particle",
	Beam = "VFX Beam", Trail = "VFX Trail", Sky = "Skybox", Shirt = "Clothing",
	Pants = "Clothing", ShirtGraphic = "Graphic",
}

local ASSET_PROPS: {[string]: {string}} = {
	MeshPart = {"MeshId", "TextureID"},
	SpecialMesh = {"MeshId", "TextureId"},
	Decal = {"Texture"},
	Texture = {"Texture"},
	SurfaceAppearance = {"ColorMap", "NormalMap", "MetalnessMap", "RoughnessMap"},
	Sound = {"SoundId"},
	Animation = {"AnimationId"},
	ImageLabel = {"Image"},
	ImageButton = {"Image"},

	Beam = {"Texture"},
	Trail = {"Texture"},

	Shirt = {"ShirtTemplate"},
	Pants = {"PantsTemplate"},
	ShirtGraphic = {"Graphic"},
}

local function extractContentIds(inst: Instance): {string}
	local props = ASSET_PROPS[inst.ClassName]
	if not props then return {} end
	local list = {}
	for _, prop in ipairs(props) do
		local ok, val = pcall(function() return (inst :: any)[prop] end)
		if ok and typeof(val) == "string" and val ~= "" then
			table.insert(list, val)
		end
	end
	return list
end

		local startTime = os.clock()
		local targetToLoad: {any} = {}

			table.insert(targetToLoad, errRecord.targetInstance)
		elseif errRecord.contentId ~= "" then
			table.insert(targetToLoad, errRecord.contentId)
		end

		local retrySucceeded = false
		local latestStatus = "Unknown"

		if #targetToLoad > 0 then
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(targetToLoad, function(loadedId, status)
				if loadedId == errRecord.contentId or errRecord.contentId == "" then
					latestStatus = tostring(status)
					if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
						retrySucceeded = true
					end
				end
			end)
		else
			latestStatus = "Instance destroyed"
		end

		local elapsedMs = math.floor((os.clock() - startTime) * 1000)

		if retrySucceeded then
			if actionBtn then
				actionBtn.Text = string.format("OK %dms", elapsedMs)
				actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Success
			end
			if cardFrame then
				cardFrame.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.SuccessBg
				local s = cardFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
				if s then
					s.Color = THEME.Success
				end
			end

			task.delay(1.2, function()
				for i, item in ipairs(state.failed) do
					if item == errRecord or item.id == errRecord.id then
						table.remove(state.failed, i)
						break
					end
				end
				for i, item in ipairs(filteredErrors) do
					if item == errRecord or item.id == errRecord.id then
						table.remove(filteredErrors, i)
						break
					end
				end
				state.failedSeen[errRecord.id] = nil
				state.recoveredCount += 1
				updateUI()

				if state.activeTab == "errors" then
					if cardFrame and cardFrame.Parent then
						cardFrame:Destroy()
					end
					if #filteredErrors == 0 then
						renderErrors(SearchInput.Text)
					end
				elseif state.activeTab == "info" then
					switchTab("errors")
				end
			end)
		else
			errRecord.retries += 1
			errRecord.reason = string.format("%s (attempt %d)", latestStatus, errRecord.retries + 1)
			if actionBtn then
				actionBtn.Text = "Fail"
				actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Danger
				task.delay(1.4, function()
					actionBtn.Text = "Retry"
					actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Accent
				end)
			end
			if state.activeTab == "info" and currentRecord == errRecord then
				DiagStatus.Text = errRecord.reason
			end
			updateUI()
		end
	end)
end

-- O(1) Pointer Queue + Concurrent Worker Pool
local assetQueue: {Instance} = {}
local queueHead = 1
local queueTail = 0

local function processBatch(batch: {Instance})
	if #batch == 0 then return end
	local leader = batch[1]
	if leader and leader.Parent then
		CurrentPath.Text = formatPath(leader)
		CurrentMeta.Text = string.format(
			"Class: %s | Workers: %d/%d | Files: %d",
			getAssetType(leader),
			state.activeWorkers,
			CONFIG.MaxWorkers,
			state.totalFiles
		)
	end

	local uriToInstance: {[string]: Instance} = {}
	for _, inst in ipairs(batch) do
		for _, uri in ipairs(extractContentIds(inst)) do
			if not uriToInstance[uri] then
				uriToInstance[uri] = inst
			end
		end
	end

	ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(batch, function(contentId, fetchStatus)
		state.totalFiles += 1
		if fetchStatus ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
			local idKey = tostring(contentId)
			if not state.failedSeen[idKey] then
				state.failedSeen[idKey] = true
				local finalInst = uriToInstance[idKey] or leader

				table.insert(state.failed, {
					id = idKey,
					name = finalInst and finalInst.Name or idKey,
					fullName = finalInst and finalInst:GetFullName() or idKey,
					assetType = finalInst and getAssetType(finalInst) or "Asset",
					contentId = idKey,
					targetInstance = finalInst,
					reason = tostring(fetchStatus),
					retries = 0,
				})
			end
		end
	end)

	state.processedInstances += #batch
	updateUI()
end

local function spawnWorkers()
	if not state.isRunning and queueHead <= queueTail then
		state.isRunning = true
		state.activeStartTime = os.clock()
	end

	while state.activeWorkers < CONFIG.MaxWorkers and queueHead <= queueTail do
		state.activeWorkers += 1

		task.spawn(function()
			while queueHead <= queueTail do
				local batch: {Instance} = {}
				local count = math.min(CONFIG.BatchSize, queueTail - queueHead + 1)
				for _ = 1, count do
					local item = assetQueue[queueHead]
					assetQueue[queueHead] = nil :: any
					queueHead += 1
					if item then
						table.insert(batch, item)
					end
				end

				if #batch > 0 then
					processBatch(batch)
				end
				task.wait()
			end

			state.activeWorkers -= 1

			if state.activeWorkers == 0 and queueHead > queueTail then
				queueHead = 1
				queueTail = 0

				if state.processedInstances >= state.totalInstances and not state.isComplete then
					state.accumulatedTime += (os.clock() - state.activeStartTime)
					state.elapsedTime = state.accumulatedTime
					state.isComplete = true
					state.isRunning = false

					StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = (#state.failed > 0) and THEME.Danger or THEME.Success
					CurrentPath.Text = "ALL ASSETS VERIFIED"
					CurrentMeta.Text = string.format(
						"Done in %s (%d files, %d failed)",
						formatClock(state.elapsedTime),
						state.totalFiles,
						#state.failed
					)
					ChipEta.Text = "DONE"
					updateUI()
					if state.activeTab == "errors" then
						renderErrors(SearchInput.Text)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function enqueue(items: {Instance})
	if queueHead > queueTail then
		queueHead = 1
		queueTail = 0
	end

	local added = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		if not seenInstances[item] then
			seenInstances[item] = true
			if #extractContentIds(item) > 0 then
				queueTail += 1
				assetQueue[queueTail] = item
				added += 1
			end
		end
	end

	if added > 0 then
		state.totalInstances += added
		state.isComplete = false
		StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Accent
		updateUI()
		spawnWorkers()
	end
end

local pendingStream: {Instance} = {}
local streamDebounce: thread? = nil

local function onDescendant(inst: Instance)
	if isTrackable(inst) then
		table.insert(pendingStream, inst)
		if not streamDebounce then
			streamDebounce = task.delay(1.2, function()
				local toAdd = pendingStream
				pendingStream = {}
				streamDebounce = nil
				enqueue(toAdd)
			end)
		end
	end
end

bind(workspace.DescendantAdded, onDescendant)
bind(ReplicatedStorage.DescendantAdded, onDescendant)

local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
if pGui then
	bind(pGui.DescendantAdded, onDescendant)
end

local function bootstrap()
	CurrentPath.Text = "INDEXING DOMAIN ROOTS..."

	local roots: {Instance?} = {
		workspace, ReplicatedStorage, ReplicatedFirst, Lighting,
		MaterialService, SoundService, StarterPack, pGui
	}

	local found: {Instance} = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
		if r then
			for _, d in ipairs(r:GetDescendants()) do
				if isTrackable(d) then
					table.insert(found, d)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	enqueue(found)

	if state.totalInstances == 0 then
		state.isComplete = true
		state.isRunning = false
		StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Success
		CurrentPath.Text = "NO ASSETS TO LOAD"
		CurrentMeta.Text = "0 items in memory"
		updateUI()
	end
end
